# FG-GIT-0039

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`push-checks`](../../ops/runbooks/push-checks.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `bot_cannot_touch_protected_path` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このアカウントは保護されたパスを変えられないため、プッシュ全体を拒否しました。そのパスの変更を外してからもう一度プッシュしてください。
- en: This account may not change a protected path, so the whole push was refused. Remove the change to that path and push again.
- id: Akun ini tidak boleh mengubah path yang dilindungi, sehingga seluruh push ditolak. Hapus perubahan pada path itu lalu push lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 17 P17-5 (§3): the pusher holds an improvement-draft token (`improve_draft`, `pfs-ai-bot`: PFS's integration proposes improvements as draft merge requests), and a commit the push brings changes a path such a token never changes (`forge_core::improve_draft::is_protected_path`): forge's own protected paths (migrations, `.forge/`, `.forge-ci.yml`, CODEOWNERS, authorization code), the autofix bot's fixed denials (build and tool configuration, agent instructions, secret-looking names), agent configuration (`.claude/`, `.gitstation/`, `.mcp.json`, `CLAUDE.md`) and the AI asset repository's (`agents/`, `models/`, `bench/`, `evals/baselines/`, `thresholds/`), each path component also read as a developer's file system reads it (case, trailing dots and spaces, zero-width characters). The pre-receive hook diffs every commit of the pushed tips that the default branch (`HEAD`) does not hold — a branch pointed at a person's unmerged commit included — against each of its parents (`diff-tree -r -m --root`) and refuses the whole push; no ref changed. The same path in the single-file commit API (`POST …/repository/commits/single-file`) is refused before anything is written. Only a person changes these paths, through a reviewed merge request.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The pusher sees `remote: FG-GIT-0039 …` with one line per path and the commit that changed it. One warn log line `forge.git.push_checked` with `error_code`, `request_id`, `verdict=refused`, `rules` (`protected_path`), `first_path`, `first_commit`, `repo_id`. Which token: the push's `credential_id` in the `repository.pushed` audit trail of the request id, or SELECT id, user_id, scopes FROM forge.tokens WHERE user_id = <the pusher>.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing on the server: the integration must not propose changes to these paths. If PFS's improvement really needs one (a threshold, a model, the allowlist), a person makes that change in its own merge request with the protected-path approvals. A path wrongly treated as protected is a change to `forge_core::improve_draft` (ADR-0035 Amendment P17-5). Runbook push-checks.
